bundle.shortDescription: One explorer for files, networks, phones and drives
bundle.longDescription: Narada is one explorer for your files, network, phones and drives: every system on your home network and tailnet as one record, verified copies, an AirDrop-style phone drop, and another operating system's disks read safely.
